rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal construction anywhere in this file. This is a module file (metadata + LOs + ordered includes + framing per curriculum/CLAUDE.md's module-file shape); any guess/predict demo beats live inside the included lectures/exercises, out of this file's own scope.

Every chunk carries a self-standing claim: Big Idea's thesis (4), Prework's artefact instruction (8) plus reading list, the five What-You'll-Learn LOs (14-18), Start here's framing plus blockquote plus two links, the worry-beside-the-artefact three-paragraph arc (32-36), Set-up-the-worktree's rationale plus four includes plus blockquote, the four Key Concepts lines, Back-to-the-map's four-paragraph closer (still four self-carrying paragraphs after the line-63 edit), Bring-to-Module-6's carry-forward instruction (74-76), the two pre-read annotations (82, 84), Next's two-sentence bridge (88). None is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

'Big Idea', 'Prework', 'What You'll Learn', 'Key Concepts', 'Next' are architecture-mandated canonical section names (curriculum/module-shape.md), exempt from the plain-truth test by construction. 'Start here', 'Set up the worktree', 'Pre-reads before Module 6', 'Bring to Module 6', 'Back to the map, one last time' all match their chunk's content on a plain read -- 'Back to the map' still accurately describes the chunk's content after the line-63 wording edit (the map is still the subject). 'Hold the worry beside the artefact' (30) is a literal match: line 34 reads 'Hold that worry beside the artefact,' word-for-word off the header.

Scanned every chunk fresh for the five sub-shapes. No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction (line 82's 'Reliability is a number you measure, not a vibe you sense, and one verifier can become a panel' is a single sentence with one mid-sentence negation, not the banned triple). No anaphora/epistrophe triple: line 36's 'a session your checks steer is a session you don't babysit, and a session you don't babysit can run beside another' is a two-clause chain, not three legs on a shared opener/closer; line 66's five-item asyndetic list (rules file/observations/verifier/reference/plan) is not repeated-opening-word. No self-grading superlative about our own material (line 82's '10 consecutive times' describes Klaassen's external practice, not this training). No number+retraction in body voice (line 82's '10' is a plain citation, no hedge-then-walkback). No abstraction-noun stack: 'durable practice' (58) is a single compound noun inside the maintainer-locked, verbatim Key Concepts block, cleared under check_writing.md rule 2 as amended 2026-08-15. No verb triplet with an empty leg anywhere. The edited line 63 ('cross personal → team') is a two-word arrow phrase, not a cadence-tic shape of any kind.
